pages.text: A fallen companion leaves a Broken Slime Block containing its identity and saved traits, including gear and cargo. If the position is occupied, its recovery block item is dropped without replacing the existing block.

The owner can use one slimeball on the block to revive it in Wait at $(bold)one health$(). Clear enough space first. Successful Survival revival consumes one ball. Blocked placement, invalid data, or a loaded matching identity leaves everything intact.

Breaking the recovery block yields one block item carrying the saved companion. A $(l:companions/healing)Healing Slime$() can also revive same-owner or mutually shared blocks with its own slimeballs, then heal the revived companion further.
